title: Troubleshooting HTTP 401
guidance: Check credential configuration, token expiry, and authorization headers. Never share secret keys in logs or support tickets.

title: Troubleshooting HTTP 403
guidance: Verify the identity's permissions, role assignments, and resource access policy.

title: Troubleshooting HTTP 429
guidance: Inspect rate-limit responses and request volume. Apply exponential backoff and respect Retry-After when available.

title: Troubleshooting HTTP 500
guidance: Inspect server-side errors, recent deployments, dependencies, and service health.

title: Troubleshooting slow APIs
guidance: Compare latency metrics, inspect dependency health, and review recent changes before identifying a root cause.
